{{Quote|Wait! What are you ''doing?'' Those are our ''own troops!''"<br />"They sure are, bucket-head&mdash;an' look what's become of 'em! Mandalorians&mdash;with the rakghoul plague! ''Mando-Raks!''|A Mandalorian Rally Master and Wargo, fighting infected Mandalorians on Jebble|<ref name="kotor27" />}}
'''Wargo''' was a [[Drovian]] member of the notorious [[Taris/Legends|Tarisian]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang known as the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] who later joined the rampaging [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] army in the early stages of the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Rarely seen without his close [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] friend [[Frazznik]], the powerful and brutish Wargo worked for the Vulkar [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Benno]]. In [[3964 BBY]], Wargo and Frazznik encountered the wanted fugitives [[Zayne Carrick]] and [[Marn Hierogryph]], but instead of turning them in for a hefty [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]], they were convinced by Hierogryph to shake down a group of nearby [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]&mdash;and sustained a beating that cost Wargo several [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]]. When the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] [[Taris Siege|besieged]] Taris not long afterward, Wargo and Frazznik abandoned the Black Vulkars and joined the invading force, eventually being sent to a staging point on the planet [[Jebble]] in preparation for a raid on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Wargo was caught on Jebble when the influence of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact known as the [[Muur Talisman]] turned thousands into mutated [[rakghoul]] beasts&mdash;although he fought against the monsters, Wargo eventually perished on Jebble.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Didn't think you'd see me and Frazznik again after you pulled that fast one on us, hey?"<br />"Of course not, gentlemen! We're so glad to see you escaped Taris in good health!"<br />"Good health? Those Wookiees knocked out four of my teeth, mate!|Wargo and Marn Hierogryph|<ref name="kotor26">[[Knights of the Old Republic 26|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 26]]</ref>}}
A [[Drovian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Wargo lived in the [[Lower City]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as of [[3964 BBY]], where he was an active member of the notorious [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] gang known as the [[Black Vulkars/Legends|Black Vulkars]] under the the Vulkar [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] [[Benno]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], four [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] at the Taris [[Jedi Tower]] were [[Padawan Massacre|massacred]]. Surviving Padawan [[Zayne Carrick]] and local criminal [[Marn Hierogryph]] were blamed for the crime, and had extremely large [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]] placed upon their heads. Wargo and his [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] friend [[Frazznik]], also a Black Vulkar, were among the first two people to encounter Carrick and Hieorgryph as they attempted to flee pursuit from [[Taris Civil Authority|law enforcement]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]&mdash;recognizing the two from news [[Hologram/Legends|holos]], Wargo and Frazznik attempted to accost them and steal the bounty. However, Hierogryph, who was securely in Wargo's grip, correctly surmised that Wargo and Frazznik were two of Benno's boys, and managed to convince them to let them go out of fear that they would feel Benno's wrath if they tried to collect on the bounty and got him involved in [[Upper City]] justice. In exchange, Hierogryph gave them a tip: that a group of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] operating a nearby trash cart had secretly sewn stashes of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] into their pack animal's harness.<ref name="kotor3" />

The tip was actually a lie made up by Hierogryph on the spot, but it convinced Wargo and Frazznik to attempt to steal the Wookiees' cart and take the spice for themselves, a score they hoped would make their kick for the entire year.<ref name="kotor3" /> The would-be robbery went poorly, and one of the Wookiees knocked out four of Wargo's [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]].<ref name="kotor26" /> Soon afterward, the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]&mdash;in one of the major early strikes of their [[Mandalorian Wars|war]] for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] supremacy with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]&mdash;attacked and [[Taris Siege|besieged]] Taris. While many of the swoop gangs attempted to battle the invaders,<ref name="kotor22">[[Knights of the Old Republic 22|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 22]]</ref> Wargo and Frazznik decided instead to join the rampaging horde, as Wargo was attracted by the potential to wreak havoc upon the galaxy. Wargo, Frazznik and a number of other Outer Rim criminals and malcontents who had elected to sign up with the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were sent to a staging point on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Jebble]], where they were meant to prepare for an eventual Mandalorian raid on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="kotor26" />

Wargo and Frazznik soon found themselves joined by a pair of familiar faces: Carrick and Hierogryph, who had found themselves on Jebble after stowing away on the Mandalorian [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Mar'eyce]]'', which had been on Taris for a successful expedition to find the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifact known as the [[Muur Talisman]]. Still vengeful for his thrashing at the hands of the Wookiees months earlier, Wargo attempted to assault Hierogryph, but was instead smashed in the face with the butt of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] by a Mandalorian [[Rally Master]] who was attempting to keep order among the unruly hordes of new recruits. The blow cost Wargo several more teeth&mdash;soon afterward, the same Rally Master gave a speech to the assembled recruits that they would be attacking Alderaan, to Wargo's disbelief.<ref name="kotor26" /> However, the planned attack on Alderaan never came to pass, as the Muur Talisman's dark influence transmitted the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] to many Mandalorians on Jebble, turning them into rampaging [[rakghoul]] beasts. Already familiar with the rakghouls because of their notorious presence in the [[Undercity (Taris)|Undercity]] of Taris, Wargo rallied a number of survivors to battle the rakghouls, including killing his Rally Master after he was bitten.<ref name="kotor27" /> Despite Wargo's resistance, the rakghouls swept through the Mandalorian ranks and transmitted the plague to everyone they touched, before all remaining life on the planet was exterminated by a salvo of [[Nuclear weapon/Legends|nuclear bombs]] dropped by chief Mandalorian strategist [[Cassus Fett]].<ref name="kotor28">[[Knights of the Old Republic 28|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 28]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Uniforms? Ranks? What kind of rampaging horde ''is'' this?|Wargo|<ref name="kotor26" />}}
Almost always found at the side of his friend and companion Frazznik, Wargo loved nothing more than plunder and chaos, and was the muscle of the pair. Although Wargo lived on Taris and was an active member of the Black Vulkar gang,<ref name="kotor3" /> Wargo chose to join the invading Mandalorian army<ref name="kotor26" /> instead of fight against them like many swoop gangs did during their siege of Taris.<ref name="kotor22" /> However, Wargo was more interested in being part of a rampaging horde than actually following the rules and customs of the Mandalorian people, and was dismayed after learning that he would have to wear a uniform and respect ranks as a Mandalorian warrior. Wargo held a violent grudge against Marn Hierogryph after his trickery cost him a beating from several Wookiees, and had to be stopped by his Mandalorian Rally Master from attacking the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] after encountering him on Jebble.<ref name="kotor26" /> A Drovian, Wargo had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a tuft of brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="kotor3" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wargo first appeared in [[Knights of the Old Republic 3|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 3]], the third installment of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series, written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and released in [[2006]].<ref name="kotor3" /> Wargo later appeared in [[Knights of the Old Republic 26|two]] [[Knights of the Old Republic 27|issues]] in the [[2008]] story arc ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Vector]]''.<ref name="kotor26" /><ref name="kotor27" /> In his comic appearances, Wargo was illustrated by [[Brian Ching]]<ref name="kotor3" /> and [[Scott Hepburn]].<ref name="kotor26" />
